a model-generated answer as the ground truth by itself

generationMethod.inputPolicy: Use synthetic Korean text and numeric values only; do not copy real user records, account identifiers, credentials, or incident reports.
steps: Identify stable, testable product contracts in the repository.
Draft minimal synthetic positive, negative, boundary, high-risk, and adversarial inputs.
Derive expected values from source-code behavior or an explicit readiness policy.
Attach repository-relative sourceRefs to every case.
Run iterative consistency, security, runtime, version, and hash reviews.
Keep runtime evaluation free of external URL calls, same-Worker self-fetch, and billable AI generation.

oraclePolicy.codeDerived: Exact calculations, normalized values, document IDs, intent enums, rule signals, and triage scores are derived from repository code contracts.
oraclePolicy.policyDerived: Health, freshness, and runtime-provider expectations are submission-readiness thresholds and may vary by environment and time.
oraclePolicy.modelAuthority: The language model proposes and reviews cases but is not the independent oracle.

distribution.classificationType: mutually exclusive primary scenario class for documentation only
distribution.highRiskDefinition: A high-risk financial-harm situation such as phishing or suspicious transactions; never a demographic or person-level risk group.

negative, non-numeric, and maximum-value normalization contract
exact decimal-to-won precision and formatting contract
allowlisted signal scoring and priority contract
unknown, cross-domain, and duplicate signal rejection contract
shared build-contract constants; not a public availability probe
internal health-handler response and readiness policy
internal dashboard handler plus live-source, item-count, and freshness thresholds
shared text-only phishing rule core; not an HTTP-route assertion
shared text-only phishing rule core negative control; not an HTTP-route assertion
runtime provider configuration readiness policy; no generated response is scored

modelAssistedReview: dataset hash, line-ending, and runner-version pinning
releaseEvidenceRequired: manual financial, legal, accessibility, and fairness review

limitations: The dataset has only 16 cases and is a regression smoke set, not a statistical benchmark.
All cases are Korean and do not measure multilingual quality.
Cases are white-box and derived from the same repository they evaluate.
Synthetic inputs do not represent real-user prevalence, severity, or demographic distributions.
Only one case has adversarial as its primary class.
No independent financial, legal, security, or fairness expert labels are recorded.
Health, public-data freshness, and runtime-provider results vary by environment and time.
The phishing shared-core cases do not prove HTTP parsing, rate limiting, routing, or deployed availability.
The challenge build-contract case does not prove that the public route is reachable.
No billable generative-AI response quality, hallucination, or safety behavior is scored.
The model provenance is a self-described session record without a portable run ID or cryptographic signature.

procedure: Check out the exact repository commit to be reproduced.
Verify Git attributes report text=set and eol=lf for the fixture.
Compute the raw SHA-256 and compare it with this manifest and lib/judge-evaluation.ts.
Install dependencies from the committed lockfile.
Run the focused dataset test and the project test suite.
Create a fresh build so that stale dist artifacts cannot be deployed.
Retain the exported dataset ID, hash, runner version, timestamps, runtime snapshot, Git commit, and test logs.
Perform separate deployed-URL and human domain review before making external claims.

maintenancePolicy.fixtureByteChange: Recompute and update the dataset SHA-256 everywhere it is pinned.
maintenancePolicy.runnerSemanticChange: Increment runnerVersion and reject incompatible stored sessions.
maintenancePolicy.incompatibleSchemaChange: Publish a new dataset file and datasetId.
maintenancePolicy.provenanceOnlyChange: Do not change the fixture hash or runner version; track the documentation change in Git.
maintenancePolicy.singleRuntimeSource: bora-judge-core-v1.json remains the only fixture source imported by the runner.
